items.reason: pkg/expr/reader.go:194-199 performs a redundant flag check because both branches return false. Disabling SQL is intentional: this PR also replaces the database implementation with error-returning stubs at pkg/expr/sql/db.go:12-21, consistent with its commit message. The redundant check is a nit; severity reflects the comments’ claimed feature failure, assuming it were unintended.

pkg/expr/reader.go:195 assigns the negated feature flag to `enabled`, so the name describes the opposite of its value. Both branches return false at lines 197 and 199, making this a naming issue without behavioral impact.

pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23-29 does call the error-returning stub in pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16-17. However, every test in pkg/expr/sql/parser_test.go immediately calls t.Skip() (for example, lines 10, 19 and 29), so the claimed existing-test failures cannot occur.
